403.error: This device is paired for chat only. Pair it again with full control from Settings → Silicon Buddy on the Mac.

404.error: No phone model with that id. GET /ondevice/models lists the ones this Mac can fetch for a phone.

409.error: This Mac does not have that model ready yet. Ask for it with POST /ondevice/models/{id}/prepare, and fetch it once GET /ondevice/models says it is ready.

411.error: This server needs a Content-Length. Chunked bodies are not read.

413.error: That request body is larger than this device may send (4194304 bytes).

416.error: That byte range is not inside this file.

503.error: The drive “External SSD” that holds this Mac's model library is not connected, and the phone models are kept beside the library. Connect it and try again — the Mac will not put them on its startup disk instead.

swarm.error: A swarm node may not fetch or manage the models this Mac keeps for your phone. They are for the owner's own devices: pair one from Settings → Silicon Buddy.

summary: The verified file. Answers bytes, not JSON: `application/octet-stream`, `Content-Length`, `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, an `ETag` that is the quoted SHA-256, `X-Content-SHA256` and `Content-Disposition: attachment`. 206 for a `Range` — `bytes=N-` resumes with exactly the rest — and 304 for a matching `If-None-Match`. Resume with `If-Range` set to the `ETag`: a 200 to that request means the file is not the one you started, so discard the partial and keep the whole body.
